usage: bike-export [-h] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--json-only] [--xml-only]

Export MuJoCo MJCF XML models and JSON geometry data.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-dir, -o OUTPUT_DIR
                        Target output directory for generated MJCF XML and
                        JSON files (default: output/models).
  --json-only           Export only coordinates.json without generating XML
                        models.
  --xml-only            Export only MuJoCo XML models without exporting JSON
                        data.
